content.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Senior Manager, Support Engineering (U.S. Government)

An overview of this role

As a Senior Manager, Support Engineering on our U.S. Government support team, you’ll co-lead a team of engineers supporting complex enterprise deployments in highly regulated environments. You’ll combine people-focused leadership, technical judgment, and business acumen to develop engineers, strengthen our support program, and help customers realize value from GitLab.

You’ll also connect the team’s technical contributions to outcomes that matter across the business. This includes telling a compelling, evidence-based story about how Support Engineering helps protect revenue, enable growth, remove barriers to adoption, and accelerate customer time to value. You’ll help executives and sales teams understand the significance of the work engineers perform and how that work supports customer and organizational success.

Beyond individual cases, you’ll recognize Support Engineering as a valuable source of business intelligence. By bringing together engineers’ firsthand observations, product trends, and recurring customer pain points, you’ll turn field signal into actionable insights for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

What you’ll do

Co-lead, coach, and develop a team of Support Engineers, building a culture of trust, accountability, technical excellence, and customer-focused decision-making.

Drive hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development, helping engineers build technical expertise, communication skills, and an understanding of their broader business impact.

Partner with other Support Engineering Managers to shape program strategy, establish priorities, plan capacity, and evolve processes and tooling as customer and business needs change.

Translate complex technical work into clear, compelling narratives for executives and sales teams, connecting engineers’ contributions to revenue protection, growth opportunities, customer adoption, and faster time to value.

Use operational data, customer context, and qualitative feedback to evaluate support effectiveness, communicate impact, and guide investment and improvement decisions.

Establish a repeatable approach to capturing engineers’ insights and identifying product trends, recurring customer pain points, adoption barriers, and emerging government requirements.

Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to turn support intelligence into actionable recommendations for product improvements, enablement, and customer engagement.

Maintain technical engagement by joining customer calls, reviewing tickets, and helping engineers navigate complex or sensitive issues, while developing the team’s ability to resolve challenges independently.

Coordinate responses to escalated and critical customer situations during working hours, providing clear communication and sound judgment.

Champion improvements that address recurring problems, reduce customer friction, and strengthen the quality and scalability of our U.S. Government support offering.

What you’ll bring

Demonstrated success leading and developing technical support or engineering teams, including coaching, performance management, career development, and leadership through growth and change.

A strong technical background supporting complex enterprise software or infrastructure, with the ability to assess technical challenges, recognize the value engineers deliver, and understand the implications for customer outcomes.

Experience translating technical accomplishments into business value for executive and sales audiences, using clear storytelling supported by data and customer context.

Business acumen to connect support outcomes with revenue protection, customer retention, growth, product adoption, and time to value.

The ability to treat engineers’ knowledge and customer interactions as sources of business intelligence, synthesizing individual observations into meaningful trends and actionable recommendations.

Experience setting priorities, planning resources, and improving support programs while balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term organizational goals.

A people-focused leadership approach that builds trust, encourages candid feedback, recognizes contributions, and creates opportunities for engineers to grow.

Experience managing high-severity incidents and sensitive escalations, including effective communication with customers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.

The ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, building alignment around customer needs and shared business outcomes.

Familiarity with U.S. Government customers and the operational, security, and regulatory constraints that shape their environments. We also welcome candidates with relevant experience in other complex or regulated industries.

About the team

Our U.S. Government Support team formed in 2019 and has grown alongside the adoption of GitLab within government agencies. We help customers troubleshoot complex environments and use GitLab’s DevSecOps platform securely and effectively.

Distributed across the United States, we combine synchronous and asynchronous collaboration to support customers and build strong working relationships in a remote-first environment. Our team includes both tenured and newer engineers, bringing diverse technical experience and perspectives.

We’re focused on developing our people, scaling our operations, strengthening crisis management for sensitive systems, and deepening our partnerships across GitLab. As a senior leader, you’ll help make the team’s technical expertise and customer knowledge more valuable to the broader organization, while ensuring engineers have the support, direction, and development opportunities they need to succeed.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$126,400—$213,600 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

Flexible Paid Time Off

Team Member Resource Groups

Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Growth and Development Fund

Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
